#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, Default, PartialEq, Eq)]
#[repr(C, align(8))]
pub struct SleRegistrationSnapshot {
    pub generation: u64,
    pub version: u32,
    pub state: u32,
    pub profile: u32,
    pub phase: u32,
    pub error: i32,
    pub dev_index: u16,
    pub bus: u8,
    pub reserved_byte: u8,
    pub reserved: [u8; 8],
}
state_space: All bit patterns of every ABI field, full u16 index and u64 generation; no assumptions or unwinding loops
properties: Accepted decoded observations preserve requested index/generation, nonzero identity, version, reserved bytes, known bus/state and pending/fault/installed/retiring diagnostic constraints
scope: Actual production SDK valid_for predicate only. Not Core producer/mutex/lifetime/availability/Ready, wire parser, C/Python wrapper, authorization, callback or hardware proof
counterexample_mapping: SDK registration_tests::core_observation_requires_exact_identity_and_consistent_diagnostics, generation=7/index=2 rejects expected generation=8; hypothetical weak validator, not a Core or hardware fault
